status: candidate selected on development; independent control verification pending
selection_basis: Removing the final support cutoff restores many threshold-flicker gaps while keeping all earlier pair gates and tracking.
Use the tighter radial displacement cap of 3 rather than restoring the historical 4-pixel tolerance associated with a chained fusion.

All nine representative development connection tracks longer than 12 pixels were inspected against CT and probabilities; they follow plausible continuations, including weak/low-probability examples. They are not rejected solely for having low model probability.
The extension from 12 to 21 supplies additional longer repairs beyond the support-only change; no raw foreground is erased.
The 21-pixel cap follows the existing implementation and historical dose-response evidence. It is not an arbitrary unbounded reach increase.
limitations: These are qualitative CT/model-supported decisions, not newly acquired ground-truth join labels.
Representative-plane review does not certify all 3D chains or universal cross-wrap safety.
Most recovered gaps are short; this does not claim broad reconstruction of wholly missing sheet geometry.
The source name extended_safe is a preset identifier, not a proof of anatomical safety.
control_policy: Run report_baseline versus extended_safe only; no control-based parameter tuning.
